ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) encryptor — mass .inc rewrite + INC-README note drop
ucs.description: Detects the terminal stage of an INC Ransom intrusion: the encryptor mass-appending the '.inc' extension to victim files while dropping the actor's signature 'INC-README.txt'/'INC-README.html' ransom note. The note filename is unique to this G1032 crew and is the highest-fidelity discriminator from other ransomware families.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count, dc(Filesystem.file_path) as distinct_files, values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_names, values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.inc" OR Filesystem.file_name="INC-README.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="INC-README.html") (Filesystem.action=created OR Filesystem.action=modified OR Filesystem.action=renamed) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| eval ransom_note=if(match(mvjoin(file_names,","),"(?i)INC-README"),1,0)
| where distinct_files > 50 OR ransom_note=1
| sort - distinct_files
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where FileName endswith ".inc" or FileName matches regex @"(?i)^INC-README\.(txt|html)$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize EncryptedFiles = dcountif(FolderPath, FileName endswith ".inc"),
            RansomNotes = countif(FileName matches regex @"(?i)INC-README"),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Proc = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            ProcCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            ProcPath = any(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where EncryptedFiles > 50 or RansomNotes > 0   // 50 = sustained bulk-rewrite floor; any note fires alone
| order by EncryptedFiles desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileCreate")
| where TargetFileName endswith ".inc" or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^INC-README\.(txt|html)$"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| summarize EncryptedFiles = dcountif(TargetFilePath, TargetFileName endswith ".inc"),
            RansomNotes = countif(TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)INC-README"),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Proc = any(ActingProcessName), ProcCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
          by DvcHostname, ActingProcessId, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where EncryptedFiles > 50 or RansomNotes > 0
| order by EncryptedFiles desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom Encryptor Activity (.inc extension + INC-README note)
id: 9c1f0a2e-3b6d-4e21-8f44-7a2c9d5e1b30
status: experimental
description: Detects file writes consistent with INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC / G1032) encryption and ransom-note drop
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
  - https://www.secureworks.com/research/gold-ionic-deploys-inc-ransomware
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  encrypted_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.inc'
  ransom_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\INC-README.txt'
      - '\INC-README.html'
  condition: encrypted_ext or ransom_note
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate '.inc' source/include files written individually (low volume); pair with volume threshold in SIEM
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.g1032
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*.inc OR *.INC) OR @TargetFilename:(*\\INC-README.txt OR *\\INC-README.html OR *\\inc-readme.txt OR *\\inc-readme.html))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| (TargetFileName=/\.inc$/i OR TargetFileName=/\\INC-README\.(txt|html)$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=([count(field=TargetFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_files), collect([TargetFileName], limit=5)]))
| distinct_files > 50 OR (regex("INC-README", field=TargetFileName))
ucs.rationale: The 'INC-README.txt'/'INC-README.html' note name and '.inc' extension are signature artifacts of INC Ransomware (S1139) deployed by G1032 / GOLD IONIC — not shared with LockBit, Akira, or other crews. Volume-gating the extension match while letting the named note fire standalone keeps FPs near zero (the only collision being individually-edited C/C++ '.inc' include files, which never appear at bulk

ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom double-extortion staging — 7-Zip/WinRAR archive then rclone/MEGAsync egress to MEGA
ucs.description: Hunts INC Ransom's pre-encryption data theft: bulk archiving of staged data with 7-Zip/WinRAR followed by exfiltration to MEGA cloud storage via rclone or MEGAsync. GOLD IONIC characteristically exfiltrates to MEGA before detonating the encryptor for double extortion.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count, values(Processes.process) as cmdline, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","megasync.exe","MEGAsync.exe") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe","rar.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*a -*","* a *","*-mx*","*-hp*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval is_exfil=if(match(process_name,"(?i)rclone|megasync"),1,0), is_archive=if(match(process_name,"(?i)7z|rar"),1,0)
| stats values(process_name) as tools, values(cmdline) as cmds, sum(is_exfil) as exfil_evt, sum(is_archive) as archive_evt, min(firstTime) as firstTime, max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user
| where exfil_evt>0 AND archive_evt>0
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let StageWindow = 6h;
let Archivers = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" a "," a -","-mx","-hp","-r ")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize ArchiveTime = min(Timestamp), ArchiveCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceName, AccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","megasync.exe") 
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega")
     or (FileName =~ "rclone.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move","--config"))
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner Archivers on DeviceName, $left.AccountName == $right.AccountName
| where Timestamp between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + StageWindow)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveTime, ArchiveCmd,
          ExfilTool = FileName, ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ArchiveTime)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let StageWindow = 6h;
let Archivers = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe") or TargetProcessName has_any ("7z.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe")
    | where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any (" a ","-mx","-hp") or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (" a "," a -","-mx","-hp","-r ")
    | summarize ArchiveTime = min(TimeGenerated), ArchiveCmd = any(TargetProcessCommandLine) by DvcHostname, ActorUsername;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("rclone.exe","megasync.exe")
     or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","userstorage.mega","copy","sync","--config")
| join kind=inner Archivers on DvcHostname, $left.ActorUsername == $right.ActorUsername
| where TimeGenerated between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + StageWindow)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ArchiveTime, ArchiveCmd,
          ExfilTool = TargetProcessName, ExfilCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ArchiveTime)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: rclone/MEGAsync Exfiltration to MEGA (INC Ransom staging)
id: 4e7b2c91-5a8f-4d63-b1e2-0c9f8a4d2e57
status: experimental
description: Detects rclone/MEGAsync execution or any process referencing MEGA cloud endpoints, consistent with INC Ransom (G1032) double-extortion exfil
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  tool:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\megasync.exe'
  mega_endpoint:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'mega.co.nz'
      - 'mega.io'
      - 'userstorage.mega'
  condition: tool or mega_endpoint
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned MEGA/rclone backup workflows; baseline known hosts/users
level: high
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1537
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.g1032
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\rclone.EXE OR *\\megasync.exe OR *\\MEGAsync.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *mega.io* OR *userstorage.mega*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\(rclone|megasync)\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|mega\.io|userstorage\.mega)", field=CommandLine))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=([count(as=execs), collect([CommandLine], limit=3), min(_time, as=firstSeen)]))
ucs.rationale: Couples INC Ransom's two observed pre-encryption behaviors into one correlation: 7-Zip/WinRAR bulk archiving (T1560.001) of staged data immediately followed by rclone/MEGAsync egress to MEGA (T1537) within a 6h window. MEGA is GOLD IONIC's recurring exfil destination; rclone-to-MEGA is rarely sanctioned in enterprises, and gating the archiver+exfil pair on the same host/user inside a tight window
